audit.whatIsWrong: diff TRICKY at 7/10 and report[14] quoting 47.49%, against a packet win rate of 54.91% over 428 games — the largest sample in my slice.
audit.why: The page reads as a losing lane and prints a losing win rate; both are the wrong side of even.
audit.corrected: diff EVEN, 5/10, tone recoloured, both percentages restated at 54.91%.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] places Highlander at level 5. Highlander is the ultimate — level 6 — and that row's label is Level 6.
audit.why: Promising the ult a level early invites a commit the player cannot back up.
audit.corrected: whys[4] now says 'At 6'. The chart itself matches the packet in both layers and needed no flips.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer says Highlander 'cleanses his slows' (late, wants.you[1], spikes[2]). Renekton has no slow anywhere in his kit, and Highlander grants immunity to slows — it does not cleanse, and it does nothing at all against his one piece of CC, the W stun. Nothing stated that Ruthless Predator opens off an auto reset, cancels Meditate, or stuns 1.5s when he holds 50+ Fury.
audit.why: A player who believes his ult answers Renekton's CC will press R and walk into the stun. The real rule is the opposite: R does not help, so bait the W first.
audit.corrected: Slow-immunity claims removed and replaced with the W's 16s rank-1 cooldown as the actual window; the auto reset, the Meditate cancel and the fury-empowered stun duration written in.
sources: ownerKit R 'immune to all slowing effects'

audit.whatIsWrong: Cull the Meek heals him every 7s and nothing on the page ties that to Grievous Wounds timing.
audit.why: It is why chip damage never sticks on him in an extended trade.
audit.corrected: spikes[0] now names the 7s heal and the anti-heal requirement.

edits.before: His Ruthless Predator (W) stun comes online and locks you at level 2.
edits.after: Ruthless Predator (W) comes online at 2 and it cancels Meditate.

edits.before: At level 5 your Highlander (R) and approaching item flip kill pressure to you.
edits.after: At 6 Highlander (R) and your approaching item flip kill pressure to you.

edits.before: Renekton bullies you through 4: with a Ruthless Predator (W) stun into Cull the Meek (Q) heal and Slice and Dice (E) dashes he can pin you and win every trade, and your Alpha Strike (Q) can't out-sustain his fury-healed Q.
edits.after: Renekton bullies you through 4: Ruthless Predator (W) opens off an auto reset and stuns 1.5s once he holds 50 Fury, and Cull the Meek (Q) heals him every 7s — without Grievous Wounds your chip does nothing and the trade is his.

edits.before: Once your Kraken/BORK lands you flip the matchup: pop Highlander (R) to ignore his slows and Alpha Strike (Q) through his E dash, and his lack of hard CC after the W stun means he can't lock you long enough.
edits.after: Once your Kraken/BORK lands you flip the matchup: Ruthless Predator (W) is his only lockdown at 16s rank 1, and Highlander does not break a stun — so bait the W out, then Alpha Strike in while it is down.

edits.before: Renekton runs levels 1-4: his Ruthless Predator (W) stun, fury-empowered Cull the Meek (Q) self-heal, and double Slice and Dice (E) dashes let him engage, out-trade, and disengage at will. Play for CS, never fight into his stun, and avoid getting chunked below all-in range.
edits.after: Renekton runs levels 1-4: his Ruthless Predator (W) stun cancels Meditate mid-channel, fury-empowered Cull the Meek (Q) heals him off every trade, and double Slice and Dice (E) dashes let him engage and leave at will. Play for CS and never channel while his W is up.

edits.before: With your first item online and beyond you take over. Highlander (R) cleanses his slows and lets you stick, your on-hit DPS melts through Dominus (R) bonus HP, and R resets on kills let you run the game.
edits.after: With your first item online and beyond you take over. Highlander's speed lets you stick through Slice and Dice, your on-hit DPS melts the bonus HP Dominus grants, and R resets on kills let you run the game.

edits.before: Use Highlander (R) to cleanse his slows and stick through Slice and Dice (E)
edits.after: Bait Ruthless Predator (W) before committing — Highlander won't break a stun

edits.before: It's a 7/10 because the entire early lane is conceded to a point-and-click bully who can kill you through your only escape, and one mistimed Alpha Strike or eaten W stun pre-item snowballs him hard enough to deny the scaling that is your whole game plan.
edits.after: It's a 5/10 and you take it 54.91%: the whole early lane is conceded to a point-and-click bully who can kill you through your only escape, but he owns four stages to your three, and the three you own are the ones that end games.

edits.before: TRICKY (47.49% WR) — Renekton edges a brutal early lane, but survive to your on-hit items and the matchup flips hard in your favor; play to scale, not to win lane.
edits.after: EVEN (54.91% WR) — Renekton edges a brutal early lane, but survive to your on-hit items and the matchup flips hard in your favor; play to scale, not to win lane.

notes: Both packet.suspectNames entries are 'Ruthless Predator', which is Renekton's real W — false positives. The genuine defect on this page was the invented slow: Renekton's kit contains no slow at all, yet the content layer twice sold Highlander as the answer to one.
